finding: The existing native acceptance producer uses schema_version=1, passed and failure fields, not status and failures.
correction: Require the actual producer fields, all ten scenarios, unchanged source, revoked fixture credential and exact tested parent.
diff:
--- run-issue84-lock-validation-r1.py
+++ run-issue84-lock-validation-r2.py
@@ -153,7 +153,12 @@
             assert data["stopped"] and all(data["stopped"].values())
             report_path = child.parent / "acceptance.json"
             report = load(report_path)
-            assert report["status"] == "passed" and not report.get("failures")
+            assert report["schema_version"] == 1 and report["passed"] is True and not report.get("failure")
+            assert report["source_unchanged"] and report["publisher_credential_revoked"]
+            assert len(report["scenarios"]) == 10 and all(s["passed"] is True for s in report["scenarios"])
+            assert report["product_head"] == record["head"]
+            record["acceptance_scenarios"] = [{"name": s["name"], "passed": s["passed"]} for s in report["scenarios"]]
+            record["actual_human_reviews"] = 0
             record.update(acceptance_report=str(report_path), acceptance_report_sha256=sha(report_path),
                           qa_root=data["qa_root"], stopped=data["stopped"])
             assert all(sha(item["path"]) == item["sha256"] for item in build["binaries"])
